items.body: An astronomer is a scientist in the field of astronomy who focuses on a specific question or field outside the scope of Earth. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: A massive power blackout hits the Indonesian island of Java; affecting almost 100 million people, it is one of the largest and most widespread power outages in history.
items.body: The 2005 Java–Bali Blackout was a power outage across Java and Bali on 18 August 2005, affecting some 100 million people. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Aeroflot Flight A-13 crashes after takeoff from Baku-Bina International Airport in Azerbaijan, killing 56 people and injuring eight.
items.body: Aeroflot Flight A-13 was a scheduled Soviet domestic passenger flight from Baku, Azerbaijan to Fort-Shevchenko in Kazakhstan that crashed on 18 August 1973 shortly after takeoff, killing 56 of the 64 passengers and crew aboard. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The Korean axe murder incident in Panmunjom results in the deaths of two US Army officers.
items.body: The Panmunjom axe murder incident, also known as the Korean axe atrocity incident, was the killing of two United Nations Command officers, Captain Arthur Bonifas and First Lieutenant Mark Barrett, by North Korean soldiers on August 18, 1976, in the Joint Security Area (JSA) in the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
